suggestions.title: True in which way, said as talk
suggestions.reading: After the Human first half of Psychological First Aid, Abuse Memories' last paragraph reads [38%](https://www.pangram.com/history/6cc98b14-969e-4383-963c-b74e68eb3a1f), its "It may be psychologically true, symbolically true, literally true, partly true, or false in the form it first appeared." AI High.
suggestions.tested: With this change: [18%](https://www.pangram.com/history/9701ce68-7f42-484c-a964-69f4ef16cf8b). The AI High window is gone; AI Low is left on the paragraph.
suggestions.what: "It may be psychologically true, symbolically true, literally true, partly true, or false in the form it first appeared." becomes "It could be true psychologically, or symbolically, or literally, or only partly true, or false in the form it first took."
suggestions.why: The same five possibilities in the same order, said with their small words instead of five matching "true"s.
suggestions.stays: "The experience may matter deeply." and "You don't have to decide tonight." word for word.
suggestions.deciding: Approve puts the new line in; Revise lets you change it first.
suggestions.advice_note: Approve: the same point, and the paragraph reads less AI with it.
suggestions.found_by: Pangram after the Human first half, one part of Abuse Memories at a time
